The '''First Battle of the Sepan system''' was a raid committed by [[Dimok (people)|Dimok]] forces against a [[Ripoblus (people)|Ripoblus]] convoy that was intervened by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces under the command of [[Admiral]] [[Harkov]] in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]]

==Prelude==
After the [[Aftermath of Hoth]], The Empire sought to quell the [[Sepan Civil War]], that had been raging the [[Sepan system/Legends|Sepan system]] for generations. [[Admiral]] [[Harkov]] was sent bring the civil war to an end. His first stage was to stop a raid by [[Dimok (people)|Dimok]] forces on a [[Ripoblus (people)|Ripoblus]] convoy by destroying at least 25% of their strike team and allow survivors to report back to their leaders that Imperial forces are getting involved. The [[Prophets of the Dark Side]], however, had become suspicious and ordered their initiate [[Maarek Stele/Legends|Maarek Stele]] to pay attention to everything as they found that conflicting reports meant that things were not as it seems in this civil war. Also, Harkov's performance has not been all the Emperor had hoped for.

==Battle==
{{Quote|Ripoblus Convoy requesting assistance. We are under attack!|Ripoblus|<ref name="TF" />}}
At the start of the battle, the Ripoblus convoy hailed the Imperial capital ship the [[Protector (Victory I-class)|''Protector'']] to assist them. Harkov ordered the Dimok strike force to stand down or face the consequences.

The Dimoks claimed to be seizing illegal war supplies and could not permit the convoy to escape and warned not to interfere or they would be fired upon. Harkov's forces with the help of Imperial pilot [[Maarek Stele/Legends|Maarek Stele]] drove the strike force away by destroying at least 25% of their forces. Though the Dimoks were driven away, Stele confirmed the Dimoks' and the Order's suspicions by discovering the existence of Imperial weapons among the Ripoblus [[Modular conveyor]] group [[Asbo]], causing the Protector to send [[Delta-class DX-9 stormtrooper transport|Transport]] group [[Epsilon (disambiguation)|Epsilon]] to disable and seize the transport group for inspection. The Ripoblus then sent 3 [[Delta-class JV-7 escort shuttle]]s called [[Ayalam]], [[Noerbo]] and [[Yawnor]] to try to stop the seizure but were all destroyed in the end and the convoy was impounded by the transports.

==Aftermath==
The Dimok forces reported back to the leaders about the intervention of Imperial forces. The Ripoblus leaders angered by the attack decided to retaliate by [[Battle of Science Station Youst|attacking]] a [[XQ1 Platform|Platform]] called [[Science Station Youst|Youst]].

Meanwhile the Secret order was disturbed by the discovery of Imperial armaments inside the Ripoblus convoy as there was no legitimate way they could have acquired them. What they didn't know was that it was Harkov who had been selling them for profit.

==Behind the scenes==
The conflict is described in the game [[Star Wars: TIE Fighter (video game)|Star Wars: TIE Fighter]]. It is Battle 2 Mission 1 in the game. The primary objective is to destroy 25% of the Dimok forces. The secondary objective is to inspect the Modulor conveyor group Asbo and the secret objectives are to ensure that the capture operation is successful, as well as inspecting all primary Dimok starships.
